name: ledger
wording: the record of a context's cuts and their work packages, kept as an append-only sequence of events, each one transition of one cut or work package carrying an id of its own, so a transition recorded once is refused when repeated; its events are taken from the harness's own account of its agents as it happens, never from an agent remembering to record them: a work package is dispatched when its builder is dispatched, returned when its builder returns, and approved when its cut's assayers' verdicts return; a cut is in flight from its first dispatch and complete once every one of its work packages is approved; each cut's phase, its work packages' status and the work packages ready to dispatch next are computed from it on request; it is read and appended in the worktree the agent works in and versioned with the branch its cut is built on, so it shows that branch's state and lands with the cut's merge.
reason: Reconstitution cut (0076), parts 3 and 5: the work package record held only what agents remembered to record (215 of the execution cut's 226 runs were recorded afterwards), and one record shared by every worktree of a host let parallel cuts read each other's state.
